payload.author: claude
payload.body: CORRECTION (board audit): this delivered the SfuBackend trait + deterministic FakeSfuBackend + SfuMediaPlaneAdapter only. The ticket title mentions media placement, but media-placement.ts / cluster-media-placement.ts were NOT ported — SfuMediaPlaneAdapter has no placement seam (region hardcodes to the hint or local). That parity gap is now tracked in FR-293.
